title: Earliest domestication of common millet (Panicum miliaceum) in East Asia extended to 10,000 years ago
bibliographicNote: PNAS 106(18), 7367–7372. Main text and figure captions read. Early CS-I, III, IV grouping is based on phytoliths and radiocarbon assignments, c. 10,300–8,700 cal BP. Biomolecular results include samples BWG and CS-V-03 from the younger group. Zhao 2011 challenges the older dates.
